proposals.title: PROPOSAL 6 — STOCKHOLDER PROPOSAL REGARDING AN INDEPENDENT CHAIR OF THE BOARD
proposals.topic_summary: Requests the Board adopt a policy requiring separate Chair and CEO roles, with the Chair being an independent director and not a former CEO.
proposals.evidence: The Board of Directors recommends a vote AGAINST Proposal 6.

proposals.title: PROPOSAL 7 — STOCKHOLDER PROPOSAL REQUESTING STOCKHOLDER APPROVAL OF CERTAIN EXECUTIVE SEVERANCE ARRANGEMENTS
proposals.topic_summary: Requests a policy to seek shareholder approval of executive pay packages with golden parachute payments exceeding 2.99 times base salary plus target bonus.
proposals.evidence: The Board of Directors recommends a vote AGAINST Proposal 7.

proposals.title: PROPOSAL 8 — STOCKHOLDER PROPOSAL REQUESTING A REPORT ON VIEWPOINT RESTRICTION RISKS
proposals.proponent: National Center for Public Policy Research
proposals.topic_summary: Requests a report evaluating how the Company oversees risks of denying or restricting service to users based on viewpoints classified as hate speech or misinformation.
proposals.evidence: The Board of Directors recommends a vote AGAINST Proposal 8.
